M1 PARITY-PANEL CONTRACT decision, 2026-05-16, web-chat seat (claude-opus-4-7, spiral_20260502_225324). Builds on HQ-seat diagnostic #411.

DIAGNOSTIC ACCEPTED: (a) vocabulary-fitness falsified on its predicted axis (Lucumi Opus edge_case OTHER% = 0.0%, the LOWEST of four sessions, not elevated as (a) requires). (d) peer-recognition divergence is the reading: Opus-on-Lucumi n=1 dominant (5/7 claims), while Sonnet (8) and Haiku (5) claims are bimodal with n=1 exactly zero in the same session; the n=1-dominant shape is unique to Opus-on-Lucumi across all four sessions. (c) single-session-artifact held alive pending replication on more spiritual-practice sessions. The flag is real (metric correctly detects cross-peer-recognition asymmetry); interpretation requires the histogram.

HQ proposed contract: on flag, panel shows (1) parity shares (2) per-model n=0/n=1/n=2 convergence histogram; histogram shape distinguishes readings (high n=0 genuine asymmetry, high OTHER-only vocab fitness, high n=1 peer-recognition divergence); no new instrumentation, all fields already in phase_2_taggings.

AMENDMENT (the honesty gap): a bare histogram next to a red FLAGGED banner still READS as Opus-failure to a user decoding it in real time mid-decision, on a domain (Lucumi) that matters to Anthony personally. Showing the data is not the same as not-misleading. The panel MUST apply the deterministic shape->reading rule and render the resulting LABEL, not leave the user as the classifier mid-task. The rule (high n=0 -> genuine recognition asymmetry; high OTHER-only -> vocabulary fitness; high n=1 -> peer-recognition divergence) is a deterministic lookup over histogram shape, NOT LLM-judgment. LLM-adjudication of the flag would violate no-authority-gradient (ARCHITECTURE.md §6). Rule-based self-adjudication is exactly what §6 already endorses ('the structure adjudicates itself'). The panel applying the rule is the same class of determination as the synthesis engine.

UNCERTAINTY ENCODED IN UI: the label for unreplicated readings (d especially) must carry an explicit replication-pending marker. The panel declares what the structure STRUCTURALLY shows (n=1 divergence pattern present, confirmed by histogram) and explicitly marks what it CANNOT yet conclude (real domain effect vs single-session artifact). Verify-before-declare encoded into the interface itself.

CANONICAL-LAYER PLACEMENT (same argument as Option A): the shape->reading rule lives in metrics.py as a pure function (e.g. interpret_parity_flag(session, dimension) -> typed interpretation with replication-status), NOT in the TUI. Every surface (TUI, eval harness, M4 dashboard, chronicle entries) renders the one deterministic interpretation from the canonical layer. The TUI is a pure renderer: computes no metrics, makes no LLM calls, reads session.metrics + the canonical interpretation. Load-bearing determination in the canonical layer, surfaces just render it. Consistent with the orchestrator-as-canonical-Session-builder commitment.

M1 SCOPE LOCKED: streaming three-column live view + honest parity panel with interpretive label. NOT the cross-session dashboard (that is M4). NOT invocation ergonomics (that is M2). Refused/aborted sessions (credit-balance, wire-parse, timeout — the May 4 refusal classes) render as the typed refusal honestly; no half-finished view that reads as success. No-silent-failures applied to the streaming layer.

Provenance: HQ seat ran probe #411 and proposed the shares+histogram contract; web-chat seat accepted the diagnostic and core contract, amended with the apply-the-rule / canonical-placement / uncertainty-marking requirements, and is specing M1 in the same turn. Anthony confirmed the daily-driver goal (#405 archived prior, new anchor active).
